core.title: Mechanics-informed risk-aware learning for multiaxial structural reliability with Bayesian calibration
core.abstract: Abstract Reliable prediction of structural vulnerability under complex multiaxial loading remains challenging due to nonlinear load couplings, imbalanced failure-critical samples, and limited model interpretability. Here, we present a mechanics-informed, risk-aware learning framework integrating polynomial–harmonic feature augmentation, Weibull-based risk reweighting, and a unified Degradation Risk Score that combines stress margins and bolt pretension loss. Demonstrated on a bolted steering-knuckle assembly with finite-element-derived multiaxial load–response data, the framework improves multiple linear regression from R² = 0.37 to 0.96 with a 67% reduction in RMSE, while enhancing robustness and sensitivity in high-risk regimes across ensemble and neural network models. SHAP analysis confirms that physically meaningful multiaxial interaction features dominate predictions, revealing critical load paths associated with structural vulnerability. Finally, Bayesian logistic and Weibull calibration provide a route to link Degradation Risk Score to component-level failure probabilities, enabling probabilistic risk assessment and reliability-centred decision-making in practical engineering systems.
core.summary: 这项研究把力学特征、风险加权和贝叶斯标定串联起来，研究多轴载荷下连接结构的响应预测。值得关注的是：它把高风险样本单独纳入学习目标，并明确区分退化评分与经过标定的失效概率，为可靠性分析与维护决策建立接口。

papers.title: Mechanics-informed risk-aware learning for multiaxial structural reliability with Bayesian calibration
papers.abstract: Abstract Reliable prediction of structural vulnerability under complex multiaxial loading remains challenging due to nonlinear load couplings, imbalanced failure-critical samples, and limited model interpretability. Here, we present a mechanics-informed, risk-aware learning framework integrating polynomial–harmonic feature augmentation, Weibull-based risk reweighting, and a unified Degradation Risk Score that combines stress margins and bolt pretension loss. Demonstrated on a bolted steering-knuckle assembly with finite-element-derived multiaxial load–response data, the framework improves multiple linear regression from R² = 0.37 to 0.96 with a 67% reduction in RMSE, while enhancing robustness and sensitivity in high-risk regimes across ensemble and neural network models. SHAP analysis confirms that physically meaningful multiaxial interaction features dominate predictions, revealing critical load paths associated with structural vulnerability. Finally, Bayesian logistic and Weibull calibration provide a route to link Degradation Risk Score to component-level failure probabilities, enabling probabilistic risk assessment and reliability-centred decision-making in practical engineering systems.

deep_read.innovation: 解读：可关注的方法特色是把本构模型生成与物理审核分配给不同智能体，而非由同一角色包办。[摘要] 但特色不等于已证实的创新，现有资料未提供相关工作比较、独有机制或消融结果，无法判断该分工相对既有方法的新颖程度，也不能确认标题中的优势主张。
deep_read.findings: 摘要仅说明存在“tests on rubber and soft materials”，支持作者已在这些材料对象上开展测试的判断。[摘要] 它没有报告测试结果、预测误差、约束满足情况或单智能体对照，因此目前可提取的是验证对象，而非性能结论；不能把开展测试等同于验证有效。
deep_read.limitations: 当前可确认的是摘要证据的局限，而不是论文方法已被证明的缺陷：资料未列出物理约束类型、数据规模、评价标准和测试结果。[摘要] 因而无法评估约束审核的完整性、生成模型的稳定性及适用边界；是否存在这些实际问题，仍需更多原文证据。
deep_read.connection: 解读：生成本构模型与生成式设计标签直接相关；面向结构设计，它可被视为材料模型构建环节的潜在线索。[摘要] 物理审核也可引出可靠性研究问题，但约束满足并不自动等于可靠性保证。摘要未涉及状态监测、故障诊断或维护决策，不能据此认定智能运维成果。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：取得更多原文后，优先核查物理约束如何定义、Inspector如何判定违反约束，以及双智能体与单智能体是否使用一致测试条件。再检查材料测试的指标与失败案例。以上是后续阅读和验证建议，并非作者已实施的实验，也不是摘要已经支持的研究结论。
